# Teltel

TelTel is a telecom operator and software provider offering tools for automated voice and SMS communication, including cloud-based contact center software, Voice/SMS API, VoIP/SIP trunking, auto dialer, webphone integration, Click2Call, and webhook-based call event tracking for CRM integration.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/teltel/.

## Actions

- **Get Call List**: Retrieve a list of calls with details (duration, time, status).
- **Get SMS List**: Retrieve a list of sent and received sms messages.
- **Get Users List**: Retrieve a list of users from your teltel account.
- **Receive Inbound SMS**: Receive inbound sms via webhook.
